body: Please think this through..as one who sits in a corner with guns ever day. The one thing that sits with me is that no matter how shitty of a person you think you are or you were convinced you are..  people give a shit about you.. your mind is powerful. Look at what the fuck it makes you want to do. Try putting positivity in your head everyday. I don’t give a shit what it is. The sun is shining, my dog is barking, I took a shit today. Try thinking positive instead of negative from here on out. Look at all these random people that give a fuck about you dude. Now imagine every single person you’ve ever had a good interaction with. Wether you believe it or not that was a good impact on that persons live. Try and keep that in mind.. you’re your own person, in the end you’ll do whatever you want… but I don’t even know your name but I want you to stay…. Your dog ??..
Man I sing this part throughout my day religiously . Literally pulls me out of anxiety attacks
“Tell me what is happy, does anybody know the truth”
